notes.title: October small update
notes.content:
As a solo game developer, I really want to thank everyone for playing 1980! I also appreciate every positive and negative feedbacks.

1980 came with a tutorial system, which will guide you through your early development. However, this system will appear every single game, no matter it's your first time playing or your tenth time playing. So here comes the first update for 1980: a small button which allows you to skip all tutorials.

Have fun!
